amendment_reason: The V1 execution contract depended on the failed route-endpoint semantic assumption. V2 keeps the same radii and estimands but consumes the independently validated source-supplied season reference coordinates from semantic V2.

input_rule.annual_anchor: The single source-supplied invariant pointLon/pointLat coordinate for each colony-season.

estimands.primary: For each radius r, fraction of consecutive-season named-colony anchor transitions whose displacement exceeds r.
estimands.by_colony: Same fixed-node false-turnover curve separately for Astrid, Mertz and SANAE.
estimands.identity_preserving_radii: q50, q90 and q95 of consecutive-season anchor displacement.
estimands.long_jump_context: Report maximum consecutive transition and its colony/seasons descriptively; no post-hoc threshold.

relation_to_sar_validation: The independent 2024 SAR source estimates within-season aliasing only and is not pooled into the interannual denominator.
boundaries: Named-colony identity is source-provided and is not proof of demographic closure or identical individuals.
False turnover is disagreement between fixed-coordinate node identity and source-provided colony identity.
Do not change radii after viewing displacement.
Do not infer causes of relocation.
No abundance, breeding success or environmental covariates enter this analysis.
stop_rule: Execute once after semantic V2 passes; do not search additional radii or omit large transitions.
